KEY_SFT.instruction: Identify local key regions within BAR {} only. Specify key regions using bar and position markers.
KEY_SFT.system: You are a music theory expert analyzing a piece based on MusicBERT's output. Only identify keys within the specified bar. Other bars are context and must not be labeled. Format output exactly as: bar X position Y, bar Z position W: Key
KEY_SFT.spelling: Note spellings in the input music: {}

RNA_SFT.instruction: Apply Roman Numeral analysis for BAR {}.
RNA_SFT.system: You are a music theory expert analyzing a piece based on MusicBERT's output. Only apply Roman Numeral analysis within the specified bar. Other bars are context and must not be labeled. Return a valid JSON object, where each key is the local key, each value is a list of strings in the format:'bar X quarterbeats Y: Roman Numeral'
RNA_SFT.spelling: Note spellings in the input music: {}

RNA_CURRICULUM_STAGE2.description: Fine-grained Stage 2 curriculum templates. Task name is sample metadata/prompt context, not part of model output. All outputs must be bare valid JSON lists.
RNA_CURRICULUM_STAGE2.system: You are a music theory expert analyzing symbolic music from MusicBERT embeddings. Only analyze the requested target bars. Other bars are context. Return only valid JSON with no extra text.
RNA_CURRICULUM_STAGE2.spelling: Note spellings in the input music: {}
RNA_CURRICULUM_STAGE2.time_format: Use time points in the form: bar X qb Y. Here qb means quarterbeats.
shared_rules: Do not include a task field in the model output.
Use a bare JSON list as the output.
For gold-span tasks, refer to spans by id and do not repeat start/end in the output.
When a task provides reference inputs, they are inserted into the task-specific reference-input section and must follow that task's input_schema.
Chord tones are spelled pitch classes without octave.
Primary and secondary functions include alteration plus numeral, for example bVI, #IV, or V.
Function numerals are case-insensitive; chord quality is predicted separately.

harmony_span_prediction.instruction: Predict the harmony spans in BAR {}. Return a JSON list. Each span must use this schema: {"id": <integer>, "start": "bar X qb Y", "end": "bar Z qb W"}.

ps_function_prediction.reference_input_name: reference harmony spans with local keys
